queries.query: Ikare Akoko Ondo State official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Ondo State land-registration guide and the Ondo State Land Registry public portal. The official guide identifies the Akoko area office at State Secretariat Annex, Tanimowo Complex, Ikare-Akoko, and describes state land-title digitization/e-archiving. No anonymous public parcel geometry service was found.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official Ondo guide describes state land-title registration, digitization/e-archiving, and an Akoko area office in Ikare-Akoko.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The public portal exposes property/search/verification service pages, but no anonymous parcel layer, geometry endpoint, CRS, safe native parcel-ID schema, or bounded feature response was verified. This does not establish parcel absence or citywide absence.
